meta.title: Theme Studio
meta.description: Twenty original themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI - ink wash, celadon, parchment, moonlit, watercolor, color field, oil dusk, silver film, spring river, bamboo wind, morning page, sea horizon, lantern night, starry journey, ancient path, lotus dawn, home smoke, rain tea, summit dawn and paper wish - with animated wallpaper layers, pointer parallax and no third-party artwork.
